preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the rebase() function with a multiple > 1 to mint new tokens to the rewardsPool address. First ensure rewardsPool is set (via setRewardsPool()) to an address you control, or use the existing rewardsPool if you control it. The minted tokens can then be transferred or sold for profit, causing inflation and devaluing existing holdings.
